This leaf is found chiefly in semi-arid climates, especially in sea coasts and saltwater shores, and is best known in western Endor. Even in suitable terrain, it remains easy to find.

A Dráf leaf is swallowed, after which the patient must rest for the following hour. Under these conditions it restores 1–10 concussion hits. Each subsequent dose is only half as effective as the previous one. The leaves lose their potency after three days, limiting what a travelling party can carry.
